summary: Frontend-only test (390x844) of the WhatsApp Pass Sharing feature. Created + approved TEST registration OLM-7A21CC via API (qa-admin). /my-pass?ref=OLM-7A21CC pre-filled the reference; entering the email -> lookup -> View pass took me to /pass?ref=OLM-7A21CC, and the token is not in the URL. The QR card and the Print / Save as PDF button render. The green (#25D366) 'Share on WhatsApp' button (pass-whatsapp-btn, role=button, 358x52) sits below the PDF button. Clicking it called window.open with https://wa.me/?text=... The decoded text contains the name, branch (KALOOR), reference and the link https://olam-wedding-pass--4hk91vsk.preview.emergentagent.com/my-pass?ref=OLM-7A21CC, and does NOT contain the QR pass token. All checks passed. Test data cleaned up.

issues: White text on WhatsApp green #25D366 has a contrast ratio of about 2:1, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. This is acceptable as a brand colour but could use a darker green (#128C7E / #075E54) or dark text for readability. Minor.

action_items: Optional: in pass.tsx, add .catch() to Linking.openURL(...) (line 66) to avoid an unhandled promise rejection on devices that cannot open the URL
Optional: improve the contrast of the WhatsApp button text
critical_code_review_comments: pass.tsx:66 Linking.openURL is not awaited and has no error handling. If it rejects, the error is unhandled and the user gets no feedback.

pass.tsx:63 on native, the link base uses getPublicUrl() (the backend URL). This works because frontend and backend share a domain in this deployment, but it should be a dedicated public app URL in production.
seed_data_creation: One TEST registration (OLM-7A21CC), approved, then removed with cleanup_test_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: react-native-web Linking.openURL uses window.open, so stub window.open via add_init_script to capture the wa.me URL. Use setup_iter18_ui.py to create an approved registration and cleanup_test_data.py afterwards.
